normalization_plan.reason: _from is only meaningful as the input address of the transferFrom state transition
_to is only meaningful as the recipient consumed by transferFrom
_value is the amount consumed by transferFrom's allowance and balance arithmetic
_tos only parameterizes the owner-only batchSend loop
total is the direct product of the unchecked _value * _tos.length multiplication
loop counter i is local to batchSend's iteration logic
addedValue is the operand of the unchecked multiplication that mints balances
spender is only the beneficiary account written by _mints
token is the operand of the unchecked 10**decimals scaling in init
maxToken is the operand of the unchecked 10**decimals scaling in init
a is the unvalidated target consumed directly by the delegatecall
b is the raw calldata consumed directly by the delegatecall
_from is only the address tested by ensure's whitelist conditions
_UNI is a transient computed value used only inside ensure's whitelist check
addr is the sole value assigned to tradeAddress by setTradeAddress
